summary: INLIF Limited, a Cayman-incorporated Chinese industrial machinery issuer, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of up to 435,000 Class A ordinary shares plus accompanying Series A, B and C warrants at US$1.60 per share and warrants, with pre-funded warrants covering 1,908,750 shares for purchasers hitting the 4.99% (or 9.99%) beneficial-ownership cap. Series A/B warrants carry a 20-trading-day VWAP reset with a $0.51 floor; Series C warrants price at $0.0001. This is an ordinary equity/warrant shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and reset-driven dilution.
